gbm_population_flag.reason: All patients must be IDH1/2-mutant, so the 'glioblastoma' cohort is IDH-mutant grade 4 (not GBM under WHO CNS5) -> not_glioblastoma per manual 1.1. However, 'Recurrent Glioblastoma' is a listed condition and there is a 'GBM Arm' in historical terminology; would be mixed_glioma_gbm_named if historical definitions were accepted.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] PARP Inhibitor BGB-290 (other names: BGB-290, PARP, Inhibitor BGB-290): Given PO
BGB-290 may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase I/II Study of BGB-290 With Temozolomide in Recurrent Gliomas With IDH1/2 Mutations

role_evidence.quote: Determine the safety and tolerability of the combination of PARP inhibitor BGB-290 (BGB-290) and temozolomide (TMZ) in patients with recurrent IDH1/2 mutant glioma
Any DLT must be a toxicity considered at least possibly related to pamiparib (BGB-290) or TMZ.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: PARP inhibition; may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

role_evidence.quote: OUTLINE: This is a phase I, dose de-escalation study of temozolomide followed by a phase II study.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent (established GBM therapy), here low-dose continuous schedule

flag.reason: TMZ is given in all arms (rule 3, soc_backbone) but its low-dose continuous schedule is itself dose-de-escalated in phase I (rule 6, established_therapy_experiment). Coded rule 6 because the schedule is under investigation.

Trial selects IDH1/2-mutant tumours for a PARP inhibitor and measures 2HG and PARylation, implying an IDH-mutation/PARP-sensitivity hypothesis, but the record does not state the mechanistic link explicitly.

coder_notes: IDH1/2-mutant gliomas only (grades II-IV); the 'GBM Arm' uses WHO 2016-style terminology for IDH-mutant grade 4 tumours, which under CNS5 are astrocytoma IDH-mutant grade 4, hence not_glioblastoma (flagged). BGB-290 = pamiparib (named in outcomes). BeiGene is a collaborator (industry by [CODE]). Start date likely pre-2020 (NCT0391...), to be checked by [CODE].
